# Dependencies

Generated by `get-dependencies`.

- `base.txt`: boot, shell, network and package-management basics
- `desktop.txt`: Hyprland, Wayland, audio, file-manager and UI runtime packages
- `dev.txt`: editors, language toolchains, formatters, linters and CLI helpers
- `fonts.txt`: font packages
- `apps.txt`: user applications and hardware/vendor tools
- `aur.txt`: foreign/AUR packages from `pacman -Qqem` plus required AUR packages
- `flatpak.txt`: Flatpak application IDs
- `pacman.txt`: aggregate of all native categories for compatibility
- `paru.txt`: compatibility copy of `aur.txt`
